name: Kindra Kapuletti
source:
Childhood friend of Aiden.

Higly skilled in IT and robotics.

DJ KinK is her Alter-ego.

Heir to Kapuletti Industries.

Her parents built Artemis.

Gets temperamental when made fun of.
